decisions.reason: As a plug-in line with its own page and low carrying cost, its option value remains high while uncertainty is unresolved.
Digital twin service builds on existing capabilities and holds strategic option value despite early uncertainty.
The service is only mentioned and overlaps with Product E, so its option value appears low relative to many other resource uses.
The open development framework is close to the core offer and as a product line it provides valuable options at low marginal cost.
The identity and access service for GIS applications is close to existing expertise and still uncertain, so the option is worth keeping.
